title: release-opencode-plugin

goal.text: Publish a verified OpenCode plugin release.

requirements.summary: Release only the OpenCode adapter artifact family without npm publication.
acceptanceCriteria: Candidate preparation allocated the family-specific target version; promotion preserves it unchanged.
Focused OpenCode checks and the guarded release verifier pass.
The exact vopencode-<version> tag and GitHub Release are verified.

tasks.title: Inspect and classify the OpenCode baseline
tasks.detail: Select the authorized tested frozen candidate and verify its artifact family, sourceRevision and trial; absent a candidate, use candidate preparation and stop before publication. Read AGENTS.md and references/artifact.md; inspect branch, remotes, tags, manifests, and every worktree change.

tasks.title: Confirm the frozen candidate version and source
tasks.detail: Read the selected candidate and its source manifest mirrors, exact dependency pins and sourceRevision. Verify the allocated family-specific version; do not bump, regenerate or synchronize workspace content during promotion. Any mismatch requires a new candidate/version, not an in-place repair.

tasks.title: Verify the OpenCode candidate
tasks.detail: Require the selected frozen candidate inventory/hash, exact clean source revision, retained test evidence and seven-day trial. Read-only checks may verify template driver compatibility, but never build, export, bump or repair source during promotion. A changed input requires a new candidate.

tasks.title: Pass the exact-source gate and release
tasks.detail: With explicit publication authority, require clean source main at the tested candidate revision and complete authorized source push without divergence. Publish the exact frozen OpenCode artifact tree to the existing immutable vopencode-<candidate-version> tag and GitHub Release through its artifact owner. Record source and artifact commits separately and compare the public tree with the candidate. Never tag raw source as an installable artifact or regenerate the selected tree.

tasks.title: Verify the OpenCode release
tasks.detail: Verify tag, GitHub Release artifact evidence, repository cleanliness, and only the separately authorized platform installation refresh.

rules: Formal promotion requires the explicitly selected tested frozen candidate. Preserve its version and hashes; never bump, build, pack or export again. If no tested candidate exists, prepare a new version through beta:prepare and stop before publication.
Never publish npm packages or modify another artifact family.
Stop at the first failed release boundary.
